functions.description: Parse AEM error log line into timestamp, severity, source IP, epoch ms, HTTP method/path, Java class and message
Extract destination IP and port when message references a target host (e.g. replication failures)
Derive _time from embedded epoch millisecond timestamp

add.name: action
add.value: message && message.indexOf('failed to connect') !== -1 ? 'blocked' : message && message.indexOf('denial of service') !== -1 ? 'denied' : message && message.indexOf('Malformed request') !== -1 ? 'invalid' : 'observed'

functions.description: Normalize severity casing and derive protocol/action classification

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time
